policy_name: Liquidity, Priority Sector & Trade Finance Policy

clauses.text: The Bank shall maintain Cash Reserve Ratio as prescribed by the Reserve Bank of India under Section 42 of the RBI Act, 1934.
The Bank shall maintain Statutory Liquidity Ratio in accordance with RBI directions issued under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
The Bank shall achieve Priority Sector Lending target of 40% of Adjusted Net Bank Credit as prescribed by RBI.
The Bank shall provide export credit facilities as per RBI guidelines and internal interest rate policy.
All import and export transactions shall comply with FEMA, 1999 and RBI directions issued from time to time.
The Bank shall submit regulatory returns related to CRR, SLR, and Priority Sector Lending within RBI-prescribed timelines.
